title: Fetch an exchange rate over HTTP without leaking net/http
task: We need a `rates` package that fetches the exchange rate for a pair like `USDEUR` from a JSON endpoint: `GET {base}/rates/{pair}` answers `{"rate": 0.91}`. Give me something built from a base URL with a `Lookup(pair string) (Rate, error)` method, tested against `net/http/httptest`. The rest of the system only ever needs the rate; nothing outside this package should have to know we use net/http. A non-200 response or bad JSON is an error that says which pair failed.
